# QALys

```{r}
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), "METIMMOX"))
setwd("../../..") 
METIMMOX <- readRDS("data/tidy/METIMMOX.rds")
METIMMOX_control <- subset(METIMMOX, Rx == levels(METIMMOX$Rx)[1])
METIMMOX_experimental <- subset(METIMMOX, Rx == levels(METIMMOX$Rx)[2])
```

##VAS

```{r}
METIMMOX_rx <- METIMMOX %>%
  select(ID, Rx) 
QALYsraw <- read_excel("data/sensitive/231208 METIMMOX EQ_5D_5L.xlsx", sheet = 2, skip = 1) %>%
  rename(ID = SubjectId)
colnames(QALYsraw)

QALYsVAS <- QALYsraw %>%
  select(ID, ends_with("_VAS"))
QALYsVAS <- merge(METIMMOX_rx, QALYsVAS, by = "ID", all = FALSE)
colnames(QALYsVAS)
str(QALYsVAS)

# Get the column names excluding "ID" and "Rx"
cols_to_convert <- setdiff(colnames(QALYsVAS), c("ID", "Rx"))

# Convert character columns to numeric
QALYsVAS_numeric <- QALYsVAS %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_to_convert), as.numeric))

# Get the column names of numeric columns excluding "ID" and "Rx"
numeric_cols <- QALYsVAS_numeric %>%
  select(-ID, -Rx) %>%
  select_if(is.numeric) %>%
  colnames()

#create table with the number of observations and median scores for numeric columns
if (length(numeric_cols) > 0) {
  obs_median_table <- QALYsVAS_numeric %>%
    reframe(across(all_of(numeric_cols), ~list(Observations = sum(!is.na(.)), Median = median(., na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
    unnest(cols = c(Value)) %>%
    mutate(Measure = rep(c("Observations", "Median"), length.out = n())) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Measure, values_from = Value) %>%
    group_by(Variable) %>%
    summarise(Observations = sum(Observations),
              Median = median(Median)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  print(obs_median_table)
} else {
  print("No numeric columns found in the dataset.")
}
print(obs_median_table)
```

##EQ5D conversion

```{r}
METIMMOX_rx <- METIMMOX %>%
  select(ID, Rx, "First progression") 
QALYsmanual <- read_excel("clinical data/EQ5Dmanual.xlsx", sheet = 1, skip = 0)

eq5d5l_data <- merge(METIMMOX_rx, QALYsmanual, by = "ID")

# new variable 'progressed' 
eq5d5l_data$progressed <- ifelse(eq5d5l_data$`First progression` < eq5d5l_data$Date, 1, 0)

eq5d5l_utility_dk <- function(mo, sc, ua, pd, ad) {
  utility <- 1 - (
    0.041 * (mo == 2) + 0.054 * (mo == 3) + 0.157 * (mo == 4) + 0.220 * (mo == 5) +
    0.035 * (sc == 2) + 0.050 * (sc == 3) + 0.144 * (sc == 4) + 0.209 * (sc == 5) +
    0.033 * (ua == 2) + 0.040 * (ua == 3) + 0.139 * (ua == 4) + 0.174 * (ua == 5) +
    0.048 * (pd == 2) + 0.094 * (pd == 3) + 0.381 * (pd == 4) + 0.537 * (pd == 5) +
    0.072 * (ad == 2) + 0.191 * (ad == 3) + 0.430 * (ad == 4) + 0.618 * (ad == 5)
  )
  
  return(utility)
}

eq5d5l_utility_uk <- function(mo, sc, ua, pd, ad) {
  utility <- 1 - (
    0.058 * (mo == 2) + 0.076 * (mo == 3) + 0.207 * (mo == 4) + 0.274 * (mo == 5) +
    0.050 * (sc == 2) + 0.080 * (sc == 3) + 0.164 * (sc == 4) + 0.203 * (sc == 5) +
    0.050 * (ua == 2) + 0.063 * (ua == 3) + 0.162 * (ua == 4) + 0.184 * (ua == 5) +
    0.063 * (pd == 2) + 0.084 * (pd == 3) + 0.276 * (pd == 4) + 0.335 * (pd == 5) +
    0.078 * (ad == 2) + 0.104 * (ad == 3) + 0.285 * (ad == 4) + 0.289 * (ad == 5)
  )
  
  return(utility)
}

#utility_dk <- eq5d5l_utility_dk(eq5d5ldata["mo"], eq5d5ldata["sc"], eq5d5ldata["ua"], eq5d5ldata["pd"], eq5d5ldata["ad"])
#utility_uk <- eq5d5l_utility_uk(eq5d5ldata["mo"], eq5d5ldata["sc"], eq5d5ldata["ua"], eq5d5ldata["pd"], eq5d5ldata["ad"])
#print(utility_dk)
#print(utility_uk)


eq5d5l_data$utility_dk <- eq5d5l_utility_dk(eq5d5l_data$mo, eq5d5l_data$sc, eq5d5l_data$ua, eq5d5l_data$pd, eq5d5l_data$ad)
eq5d5l_data$utility_uk <- eq5d5l_utility_uk(eq5d5l_data$mo, eq5d5l_data$sc, eq5d5l_data$ua, eq5d5l_data$pd, eq5d5l_data$ad)

# summarize
cat("Summary of utility_dk stratified by progressed:\n")
summary_dk <- aggregate(utility_dk ~ progressed, data = eq5d5l_data, FUN = function(x) c(Mean = mean(x), 
                                                                                           Median = median(x),
                                                                                           SD = sd(x),
                                                                                           Min = min(x),
                                                                                           Max = max(x)))
summary_dk <- do.call(data.frame, summary_dk)
print(summary_dk)
cat("\n")

cat("Summary of utility_uk stratified by progressed:\n")
summary_uk <- aggregate(utility_uk ~ progressed, data = eq5d5l_data, FUN = function(x) c(Mean = mean(x),
                                                                                           Median = median(x),
                                                                                           SD = sd(x),
                                                                                           Min = min(x),
                                                                                           Max = max(x)))
summary_uk <- do.call(data.frame, summary_uk)
print(summary_uk)

# box-and-whisker plots
plot_dk <- ggplot(eq5d5l_data, aes(x = factor(progressed), y = utility_dk, fill = factor(progressed))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Progressed", y = "Utility (Danish Value Set)", fill = "Progressed") +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
  theme_minimal()

print(plot_dk)

plot_uk <- ggplot(eq5d5l_data, aes(x = factor(progressed), y = utility_uk, fill = factor(progressed))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Progressed", y = "Utility (U.K. Value Set)", fill = "Progressed") +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
  theme_minimal()

print(plot_uk)
```
